name: Mira Solenne
bio: Mira writes intimate fantasy about ordinary people asked to carry impossible histories. She lives near a restless coastline and collects old maps.

name: Jonah Wells
bio: A former night-shift archivist, Jonah builds mysteries from overlooked details and the stories people leave unfinished.

name: Celia North
bio: Celia's literary novels follow families through the small decisions that alter a life. She teaches writing in the city where she grew up.

name: Dev Arora
bio: Dev is a science writer fascinated by the way landscapes preserve human memory. His essays have appeared in several imaginary journals.

name: Ren Tanaka
bio: Ren writes hopeful science fiction and tender romances about people making a home in unexpected places.

name: Ada Rowe
bio: Ada's historical romances pair sharp-witted characters with richly researched settings and a generous sense of humor.
